title: properties.parameter.PRECTOTCORR → provisional precipitation
reason:
Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: PRECTOTCORR is source-defined corrected precipitation in mm/day in a date-keyed object. Need explicit unpivot, fill-999 handling, UTC day support and rate-versus-total semantics; do not equate to water stage or an instantaneous rain observation.

Original discovery reason (historical): No semantic reconciliation; names alone do not authorize mapping.
